deviations.scope: Dataset selection only; other protocol decisions remain open.
deviations.description: Use 2000 images per class across all 29 classes, selected deterministically with a fixed random seed, instead of an unavailable original subset manifest.
deviations.basis: Follows the per-class counts in Table 1; the printed total of 30000 is inconsistent with those counts.
deviations.effect: Scores from this subset are conditional evidence, not directly comparable reproduced targets.

deviations.scope: Train/validation/test partition of the approved 58000-image subset.
deviations.description: Use 36540 training, 4060 validation and 17400 test images, stratified equally across 29 classes; fixed seed 42.
deviations.basis: Paper specifies 70/30 training/testing but does not identify a validation split. Reserve 10% of the 70% training portion for validation.
deviations.effect: Validation is an explicit reconstruction assumption; final test data remains excluded from tuning and checkpoint selection.

deviations.scope: Wiener preprocessing only.
deviations.description: Use a 3x3 local neighborhood independently per RGB channel, estimating noise power from mean local variance of each image channel; same procedure for all splits.
deviations.basis: Paper specifies Wiener filtering without numerical settings or channel handling.
deviations.effect: Explicit conditional preprocessing assumption, not recovered author configuration.

deviations.scope: Exact backbone variants and pretrained weight identities.
deviations.description: Torchvision ResNeXt-101 32x8d, VGG-19 without batch normalization, and ViT-Base/16, all with explicit IMAGENET1K_V1 weight variants.
deviations.basis: Paper names ResNeXt101, VGG19 and ViT but leaves exact variants/checkpoints unidentified.
deviations.effect: Documented conditional initialization and architecture choices; subsequent approved decisions specify training and fusion.

deviations.scope: Spatial feature alignment, fusion operator and BiGRU input sequence.
deviations.description: Average-pool backbone spatial features to a 7x7 grid, concatenate vectors at each corresponding location, then form a row-major sequence of 49 vectors. Use ViT patch tokens without the classification token; process each image independently.
deviations.basis: The paper describes fused ResNeXt101/VGG19/ViT features and a BiGRU but does not define fusion or a sequence construction for static images.
deviations.effect: Material architecture assumption for the conditional reconstruction; not evidence of the original implementation.

deviations.scope: BiGRU dimensions, image representation and classification head.
deviations.description: One bidirectional GRU layer with 256 hidden units per direction. Concatenate final directional hidden states to 512 dimensions, apply dropout 0.5, then a linear 29-class head. Retain standard sigmoid/tanh GRU activations; do not add an unspecified ReLU.
deviations.basis: The paper specifies BiGRU, dropout 0.5 and a generic ReLU setting but leaves classifier dimensions, aggregation, dropout placement and ReLU placement unresolved.
deviations.effect: Explicit classifier reconstruction assumptions; not recovered author configuration.

deviations.scope: Training duration and backbone freeze/unfreeze schedule.
deviations.description: Use 50 total epochs: epochs 1-5 train the BiGRU and classification head with all backbone parameters frozen; epochs 6-50 train the entire model with all backbones unfrozen simultaneously.
deviations.basis: Paper states 50 epochs and describes progressive unfreezing without a schedule; curve discussion refers to 0-25 epochs.
deviations.effect: Uses the explicit 50-epoch setting; warm-up length and simultaneous unfreezing are conditional reconstruction choices. Subsequent decisions specify learning rates.
deviations.superseded_by: conditional_cost_revision and current conditional_architecture/conditional_optimization; original text retained as decision history.

deviations.scope: Base gradient optimizer, learning rates and regularization settings.
deviations.description: SGD with momentum 0.9 and zero weight decay. BiGRU/head learning rate 0.01 for epochs 1-50; backbone learning rate 0.001 once unfrozen in epochs 6-50. No learning-rate decay.
deviations.basis: Paper gives learning rate 0.01 but not a gradient optimizer, momentum, parameter-group rates or decay schedule.
deviations.effect: Explicit conditional base configuration; metaheuristic search and its potential overrides are not yet approved.
deviations.superseded_by: conditional_cost_revision and current conditional_architecture/conditional_optimization; original text retained as decision history.

deviations.scope: CS-IGWO search dimensions, bounds and base candidate.
deviations.description: Search BiGRU/head learning rate from 0.001 to 0.01 and backbone learning-rate multiplier from 0.01 to 0.1, both logarithmically. Include head rate 0.01 and multiplier 0.1 as an initial candidate. Keep architecture and dropout fixed.
deviations.basis: Paper describes hyperparameter optimization but does not identify the optimized parameters or bounds.
deviations.effect: Authorizes learning-rate overrides within these ranges; subsequent decisions specify search budget and candidate evaluation.
deviations.superseded_by: conditional_cost_revision and current conditional_architecture/conditional_optimization; original text retained as decision history.

deviations.scope: CS-IGWO population size and candidate evaluation ceiling.
deviations.description: Use 5 search agents and at most 20 candidate evaluations in total, including initial population, mutation trials and failed candidate training attempts. Include the approved base configuration among the initial five.
deviations.basis: The paper names population size and iteration limit without numerical values.
deviations.effect: Bounded exploratory reconstruction search; this does not establish convergence, candidate duration or permission to exceed the project compute gate.

deviations.scope: Candidate training duration, reset policy and final training procedure.
deviations.description: Train each search candidate for 10 epochs (5 frozen plus 5 unfrozen) using the approved training split, with identical pretrained weights and seeded classifier initialization. Evaluate on validation only. Train the selected configuration afresh for 50 epochs (5 frozen plus 45 unfrozen), without continuing a trial checkpoint.
deviations.basis: The paper does not specify candidate evaluation duration or whether trials share initialization; the previously approved final training duration is 50 epochs.
deviations.effect: Short trials may rank learning rates differently from full runs. Record this limitation; include search and final training in measured compute estimates before launch.
deviations.superseded_by: conditional_cost_revision and current conditional_architecture/conditional_optimization; original text retained as decision history.

deviations.scope: Search fitness, candidate checkpoint and tie-breaking.
deviations.description: Minimize ordinary multiclass misclassification rate on the approved validation split using each candidate's epoch-10 checkpoint. On equal validation misclassification counts, retain the earlier-evaluated candidate. Exclude test data entirely from selection.
deviations.basis: Paper describes minimizing classifier error without a clear evaluation partition or candidate checkpoint rule.
deviations.effect: Candidate fitness uses multiclass error rather than assuming equivalence to the paper's class-average accuracy; final reporting metrics remain a separate decision.

deviations.scope: Training loss and final-run checkpoint selection.
deviations.description: Use standard multiclass cross-entropy with equal class weights and no label smoothing. Complete 50 final-run epochs and select the checkpoint with the lowest validation misclassification count, retaining the earlier checkpoint on ties. Evaluate the test set only after training and selection finish.
deviations.basis: The paper does not establish its exact loss or final checkpoint selection rule.
deviations.effect: Explicit reconstruction assumptions. Candidate search fitness remains based on fixed epoch-10 checkpoints and is unchanged.

deviations.scope: Final per-class and aggregated reporting metrics.
deviations.description: Calculate one-vs-rest accuracy, precision, sensitivity, specificity and F1 for each of 29 classes, then report their unweighted means as percentages. Set undefined ratios to zero and record each case. Report ordinary multiclass accuracy separately and preserve the confusion matrix.
deviations.basis: Paper reports per-class results and averages without an available exact metric implementation.
deviations.effect: Plausible but unverified interpretation; reported scores remain conditional evidence, not comparable reproduced targets.

deviations.scope: Input resolution, interpolation, scaling, normalization and transformation order.
deviations.description: Decode RGB, apply approved Wiener filtering at original resolution, clip filtered pixels to their valid range, resize the whole image to 224x224 with antialiased bilinear interpolation and no cropping, scale to [0,1], then normalize using RGB mean (0.485,0.456,0.406) and standard deviation (0.229,0.224,0.225). Feed the same transformed image to all backbones.
deviations.basis: The paper does not define a complete image transformation pipeline.
deviations.effect: Explicit conditional preprocessing assumptions; the subsequent no-augmentation decision is implemented.

deviations.scope: Image augmentation and training example order.
deviations.description: Use no random image augmentation; apply approved deterministic preprocessing to all splits. Shuffle training examples reproducibly each epoch.
deviations.basis: No explicit augmentation policy was located in the full paper. This is unreported, not verified absent in the original experiment.
deviations.effect: Documented reconstruction assumption; do not introduce transformations later to seek agreement with the published scores.

deviations.scope: Exact backbone feature extraction endpoints and fused dimensionality.
deviations.description: Use ResNeXt101 layer4 output (2048x7x7), VGG19 features including final pooling (512x7x7), and final normalized ViT patch tokens (768x14x14, pooled to 7x7). Exclude original classification heads and ViT classification token from fusion. Concatenate into 49 vectors of 3328 features without an added projection.
deviations.basis: The paper names backbone families but does not identify extraction layers.
deviations.effect: Explicit architecture reconstruction choices; verify tensor shapes before training.

deviations.scope: Interpretation of Equation 6 and zero-error fallback.
deviations.description: Use the printed error-proportional weights for the three leaders, despite the prose contradiction. If the sum of their errors is zero, use equal weights of 1/3. Do not substitute inverse-error weights.
deviations.basis: Equation 6 weights by raw fitness; Equation 16 defines fitness as classifier error to minimize. Prose claims the best leader has the greatest weight.
deviations.effect: Retains published formula behavior; the zero-denominator fallback is a reconstruction assumption.

deviations.scope: Literal interpretation of the weighted position update.
deviations.description: Retain Equation 7's division by three after the error-weighted sum of leader-derived positions; do not replace it with a conventional weighted average.
deviations.basis: Equation 6 weights sum to one, but Equation 7 explicitly divides their weighted sum by three.
deviations.effect: Preserves the printed formula and its scaling toward coordinate zero; subsequently approved normalized coordinates and clipping are implemented.

deviations.scope: Equation 12 mutation acceptance rule.
deviations.description: Repair Equation 12 as strict-improvement greedy selection only when valid comparable fitness scores for the exact mutated and pre-mutation candidates already exist. Do not add training or validation evaluations solely for the repair. Otherwise retain the literal mutated output at this step.
deviations.basis: Equation 12 uses indistinguishable candidate notation for its comparison and outcomes; Algorithm 1 describes greedy selection.
deviations.effect: Conditional correction with zero additional fitness evaluations. Never substitute the parent wolf score for the score of a different pre-mutation position. Existing evaluation budget remains unchanged.
deviations.superseded_detail: Earlier unconditional greedy selection is narrowed by the subsequent instruction prohibiting evaluation overhead for this repair.

deviations.scope: Search coordinate representation and boundary handling.
deviations.description: Apply search equations in normalized [0,1] coordinates. Decode head learning rate as 10**(-3+x_head) and backbone multiplier as 10**(-2+x_multiplier). Clip out-of-range proposals to [0,1] before evaluation.
deviations.basis: The paper does not specify the representation or boundary policy for the approved logarithmic hyperparameter ranges.
deviations.effect: Makes coordinate zero the lower parameter bound, so the retained Equation 7 division scales weighted positions toward the lower bounds. This is a material reconstruction convention.
deviations.superseded_by: conditional_cost_revision and current conditional_architecture/conditional_optimization; original text retained as decision history.

deviations.scope: Flight-length value and random-number convention in Equations 13 and 14.
deviations.description: Use flight length 1.0 with one reproducibly drawn uniform scalar in [0,1) for each crow movement proposal, shared across both coordinates.
deviations.basis: Paper introduces flight length but does not give its value or the granularity of random draws.
deviations.effect: Defines the crow movement step as interpolation toward its selected destination; other transforms and boundary clipping are unchanged.

deviations.scope: Equation 15 probability and Algorithm 1 branch selection.
deviations.description: Treat Algorithm 1 P as Equation 15 AP and use the printed AP=1-1.01*(t/T)**3 without clipping. Choose Equation 13 when a fresh uniform scalar is below AP, otherwise Equation 14. Keep this draw separate from the movement scalar.
deviations.basis: Paper uses differing probability symbols; its formula reaches a negative value at t=T.
deviations.effect: Latest fidelity instruction supersedes the earlier approved clipping. Symbol mapping remains an explicit interpretation; negative AP yields the Equation 14 branch.
deviations.superseded_detail: Probability clipping to [0,1] was approved earlier, then removed to follow the printed expression literally.

deviations.scope: Numerical maximum search iteration count and independent stopping ceiling.
deviations.description: Set T=3. Initialize t=0, execute while t<T and increment after each completed iteration; use t/3 in the paper schedules. Keep the 20-candidate-evaluation limit independent, allowing early termination even within an iteration without schedule renormalization.
deviations.basis: Paper specifies a maximum iteration parameter but provides no numerical value.
deviations.effect: Fills a missing numerical setting while retaining iteration-based scheduling; execution may end before completing three iterations.

deviations.scope: Meaning of X_N(t+1) in Equations 13 and 14.
deviations.description: Use the position from the immediately preceding mutation/selection step as X_N(t+1), then apply the crow movement. Do not insert an intermediate fitness evaluation solely to connect these stages.
deviations.basis: The variable is not clearly defined; Algorithm 1 places mutation/selection immediately before the crow update.
deviations.effect: Explicit interpretation of the intermediate position. Retains the separate requirement that any Equation 12 correction introduce no additional evaluation overhead.

deviations.scope: Population proposal generation and leader refresh timing.
deviations.description: Fix the current leaders for an entire iteration, generate all five agent positions, evaluate the resulting candidates, refresh the leaders, then increment t.
deviations.basis: Algorithm 1 places fitness evaluation and leader refresh after the loop over search agents.
deviations.effect: Normal execution uses 5 initialization evaluations plus 3 rounds of 5 evaluations, totaling 20. The independent ceiling still applies to failed attempts/retries; no extra intermediate evaluations are authorized.

deviations.scope: Backbone normalization statistics and module modes during warm-up, fine-tuning and evaluation.
deviations.description: During epochs 1-5, keep all backbones in evaluation mode with parameters and running statistics frozen while training the BiGRU/head with dropout. From epoch 6, use training mode for all components, permitting backbone parameter/statistic updates. Use evaluation mode for the entire model during validation/testing.
deviations.basis: The paper does not specify how freezing interacts with normalization statistics or module modes.
deviations.effect: Makes the initial feature extractors fully fixed; consistently applies to candidate and final training.
deviations.superseded_by: conditional_cost_revision and current conditional_architecture/conditional_optimization; original text retained as decision history.

deviations.scope: Definitions of A, C, D and leader-derived X1/X2/X3 proposals.
deviations.description: For each current agent X and fixed leader L, use A=2*a*r1-a, C=2*r2, D=abs(C*L-X), and proposal L-A*D, with independent uniform draws per coordinate/leader/agent. Use the target paper a=2-2*(t/T)**2 and its approved weighted combination.
deviations.basis: Target paper invokes GWO coefficients and proposal positions without fully specifying their construction. Definitions are taken from original GWO, DOI 10.1016/j.advengsoft.2013.12.007.
deviations.effect: Explicit completion of omitted algorithm definitions without extra fitness evaluations; does not replace the target paper coefficient schedule or weighting.

deviations.scope: Equations 8-11 mutation notation, aggregation and random draws.
deviations.description: Mutate each leader-derived proposal separately using P*(1+gamma1*Gaussian(0,1)+gamma2*Cauchy(0,1)), with gamma1=(t/T)**2 and gamma2=1-(t/T)**2. Draw independently per coordinate, proposal and agent. Interpret Equation 11 as the arithmetic mean of the three distinct mutated proposals.
deviations.basis: Paper supplies distributions and mixing coefficients but repeats candidate symbols and does not specify whether draws are shared.
deviations.effect: Explicit executable interpretation of notation and stochastic granularity; no intermediate fitness evaluations are introduced.

deviations.scope: Initial search population and random generator.
deviations.description: Initialize agent 1 at normalized (1,1); sample the other four uniformly and independently in [0,1)^2 with dedicated seed-42 search RNG. Evaluate in numbered order.
deviations.basis: Paper requires random initialization but omits seed/distribution; inclusion of the base candidate was separately approved.
deviations.effect: Reproducible log-uniform initialization with one deliberately included base candidate.
deviations.superseded_by: conditional_cost_revision and current conditional_architecture/conditional_optimization; original text retained as decision history.

deviations.scope: Classifier-only cached search and frozen-CNN/ViT fine-tuning final training.
deviations.description: One-dimensional classifier LR search; fixed final ViT LR 0.001. CNNs remain frozen throughout. Same approved data, model, batch size and final 50 epochs.
deviations.basis: Explicit approval after rereading paper and measuring cost; exact published training recipe remains unavailable.
deviations.effect: Substantially reduces cost; result is conditional, not a comparable original-target reproduction.

limitations: Absence of located code is not proof no code exists.

References 36-39 were inspected (reference 38 in the accepted author manuscript). Four baseline accuracies match results on different datasets; the remaining accuracies and all 44 non-accuracy baseline values could not be traced to corresponding results. Copying remains an inference, not a confirmed fact.
Exact model variant and application build are unknown.
Conditional implementation exists; original target comparability remains unresolved. No conditional score is a reproduced target.
Single-seed image-level split; no established signer/session-held-out protocol. Zero exact duplicate hashes does not exclude near-duplicate or correlated imagery.
Only the proposed model was run; the eleven comparison baselines were not rerun.
Reported expense is conservative ledger accounting at historical list prices, not an invoice.

conditional_architecture.provenance: Approved reconstruction choices; paper identifies model families but not these exact variants/checkpoints.
conditional_architecture.pinning_requirement: Pin implementation revision/package versions and checkpoint file checksums before execution; named weight enums do not replace artifact hashes.

feature_fusion.alignment: Average-pool each backbone spatial feature map onto a common 7x7 grid.
feature_fusion.vit_features: Use patch-token features; exclude the classification token and restore the patch grid before spatial pooling.
feature_fusion.fusion: Concatenate the three backbone feature vectors at corresponding grid positions.
feature_fusion.sequence: Traverse the fused grid in row-major order to produce 49 spatial feature vectors per image.
feature_fusion.sample_independence: Each image is an independent example; do not construct sequences across images.
feature_fusion.provenance: Substantial approved reconstruction assumption; the paper does not define its fusion operator or BiGRU sequence layout.

classifier.aggregation: Concatenate the final forward and final backward hidden states from the single recurrent layer; use the two directional final states, not the output at the last spatial position.

dropout.placement: After concatenation of final directional hidden states, before the linear classifier.

classifier.recurrent_activations: Standard sigmoid gates and tanh candidate activation.
classifier.relu_policy: No added ReLU in the approved classifier. The paper gives a generic ReLU setting without identifying its placement.
classifier.provenance: The paper specifies BiGRU and dropout 0.5; layer count, hidden size, aggregation and dropout placement are approved reconstruction assumptions.

backbone_training.cnns: ResNeXt101 and VGG19 always frozen and in evaluation mode.
backbone_training.vit: Frozen for epochs 1-5; trainable in epochs 6-50.
backbone_training.provenance: Approved conditional interpretation: paper discusses ViT fine-tuning but does not specify equivalent CNN tuning.

resnext101_32x8d.endpoint: Output of final convolutional block (layer4), before global pooling

vgg19.endpoint: Output of features, including final max-pooling layer; exclude ImageNet classifier

vit_b_16.endpoint: Final normalized encoder patch tokens, excluding classification token; restore spatial patch grid

feature_endpoints.classification_heads: Do not use the three original ImageNet classification heads.
feature_endpoints.provenance: Approved reconstruction endpoints; not identified in the paper. Shapes correspond to the approved 224x224 inputs and must be verified in implementation.

training_modes.search: All pretrained feature extractors in evaluation mode; precompute fixed float32 train/validation features once. Train classifier only for all ten candidate epochs.
training_modes.final: CNNs always evaluation/frozen; ViT evaluation/frozen for epochs 1-5 and training/trainable thereafter; classifier training with dropout.
training_modes.evaluation: All modules in evaluation mode; no parameter/statistics updates.

base_optimizer.note: backbone_multiplier in native metrics is the derived ratio 0.001/head_lr; it was not a searched coordinate.

metaheuristic_search.candidate_training: Classifier-only SGD on cached pretrained features; identical seeded initialization for each trial.
metaheuristic_search.initialization: Agent 1 at normalized [1]; other four uniform in [0,1) with independent NumPy PCG64 seed 42.
metaheuristic_search.fitness: Validation misclassified count / 4060 at epoch 10; earlier evaluation wins ties.
metaheuristic_search.final_training: Fresh selected configuration, 50 epochs; minimum validation errors, earlier epoch wins ties; single held-out test evaluation after training.

leader_weights.formula: w_i = f_i / (f_alpha + f_beta + f_delta), using validation misclassification rate as f.
leader_weights.leader_selection: Select leaders by ascending error; retain the previously approved earlier-evaluated preference on ties.
leader_weights.zero_sum_fallback: If all three leader errors are zero, use w_alpha = w_beta = w_delta = 1/3.
leader_weights.contradiction: With error minimized, the printed formula gives larger weights to worse leaders, contrary to the prose stating the best leader receives the largest weight.
leader_weights.decision: Preserve the printed equation rather than substitute inverse-error weights. Equal weights in the zero-sum case are an explicit reconstruction fallback.
leader_weights.evidence: PDF page 8, Equation 6 and surrounding text; page 10, Equation 16. Equation 6 visually checked in the rendered PDF.

weighted_position.decision: Preserve the additional division by three exactly as printed, even though Equation 6 weights already sum to one.
weighted_position.effect: Scales toward normalized coordinate zero, corresponding to lower search bounds.
weighted_position.remaining_details: Normalized logarithmic coordinates and final-proposal clipping were subsequently approved and implemented.
weighted_position.evidence: PDF page 8, Equation 7, visually inspected alongside Equation 6.

mutation_selection.rule: Treat the repeated candidate notation as a mistake only when repairing it adds no candidate fitness evaluation. If the exact mutated and exact pre-mutation candidates already have valid comparable fitness scores, accept the mutation only on strictly lower error; otherwise retain the pre-mutation candidate, including ties. If either score would require an additional training or validation evaluation solely for this comparison, do not introduce that evaluation and retain the literal Equation 12 output (the mutated candidate) at this step.
mutation_selection.score_reuse: Reuse only fitness for the exact candidate configuration evaluated under the approved initialization, data split, training procedure and epoch-10 rule. A parent wolf score is not the fitness of a newly computed pre-mutation position.
mutation_selection.overhead_policy: No extra training, validation pass or candidate evaluation solely to repair Equation 12. The hard 20-evaluation ceiling alone does not establish zero overhead.
mutation_selection.budget_policy: All otherwise-required candidate training attempts, including failures, still count toward the approved 20-evaluation ceiling.
mutation_selection.evidence: Equation 12 on PDF page 8 repeats indistinguishable candidate notation in the condition and both outcomes; Algorithm 1 describes greedy selection.
mutation_selection.provenance: Latest instruction permits treating this as a mistake only if the correction introduces no evaluation overhead. This supersedes unconditional greedy selection; exact overhead must be checked against the implemented update order.

coordinates_and_bounds.representation: Apply search equations in normalized coordinates, with each dimension bounded to [0,1].
coordinates_and_bounds.boundary_handling: Clip out-of-range proposed coordinates to [0,1] before evaluation.
coordinates_and_bounds.equation7_effect: The preserved division by three scales weighted positions toward normalized coordinate zero, corresponding to the lower parameter bounds.
coordinates_and_bounds.provenance: Approved reconstruction choices; logarithmic search ranges were approved earlier, but this coordinate representation and boundary rule are not established by the paper.

crow_flight_length.random_number: Draw one scalar uniformly from [0,1) per crow movement proposal and share it across both search coordinates.
crow_flight_length.randomness: Use a reproducibly seeded search random-number generator; preserve its state for resumption.
crow_flight_length.effect: The crow movement interpolates toward the selected leader-derived position (or their average) without overshooting that destination during this movement step. Other search transformations and bound handling remain separate.
crow_flight_length.provenance: The paper introduces flight length without a numerical value and leaves random-number granularity unspecified. These are approved reconstruction choices.

crow_branch_selection.pseudocode_mapping: Interpret Algorithm 1 P as Equation 15 AP.
crow_branch_selection.selection: Draw a fresh uniform scalar u in [0,1). Use Equation 13 if u < AP; otherwise use Equation 14.
crow_branch_selection.randomness: Use a draw separate from the movement-step random scalar.
crow_branch_selection.remaining_detail: T remains to be chosen; t is the search iteration index. A raw negative AP makes the Equation 13 branch impossible under the specified comparison.
crow_branch_selection.provenance: P-to-AP mapping remains an explicit interpretation. The latest fidelity instruction supersedes previously approved probability clipping: retain the printed AP value, even outside [0,1], and execute the printed comparison against a uniform random draw.

schedule_mapping.t: Search iteration index, initialized at 0 and incremented by 1 after a completed iteration.
schedule_mapping.loop: while t < 3; planned iteration indices are 0, 1, 2.
schedule_mapping.schedule: Use t/3 in the published coefficient formulas. Do not renormalize progress when the evaluation ceiling stops the search early.
schedule_mapping.stopping: The independent approved 20-candidate-evaluation ceiling may interrupt an iteration and stop the search before all three iterations complete.
schedule_mapping.provenance: Iteration semantics follow Algorithm 1. The numerical maximum of 3 is an approved reconstruction setting because the paper does not supply T.

crow_starting_position.interpretation: The position produced by the immediately preceding mutation/selection step. Apply the crow-search movement to that position.
crow_starting_position.evaluation_policy: Do not insert a fitness evaluation between mutation/selection and crow movement solely to connect these stages. The approved zero-overhead Equation 12 policy remains in force.
crow_starting_position.basis: Algorithm 1 orders weighted position updating, mutation/selection, then the crow update; the paper does not clearly define X_N(t+1).
crow_starting_position.provenance: Approved interpretation of an undefined intermediate variable, preserving the published stage ordering without an added evaluation.

steps: Hold the current three leaders fixed throughout each search iteration.
Construct all five new agent positions using those fixed leaders and the approved weighted-position, mutation/selection and crow-update sequence.
Refresh the leaders after the population evaluations, then increment the iteration index.
population_updates.budget_policy: The 20-evaluation ceiling remains authoritative. Failed attempts and any separately permitted retries consume slots. Do not exceed the ceiling to finish an iteration.
population_updates.intermediate_evaluations: Do not insert mutation or pre-mutation evaluations solely for Equation 12; use the previously approved zero-overhead policy.
population_updates.provenance: Approved ordering follows Algorithm 1, which places fitness computation and leader refresh after the loop over agents.

definitions.a: 2 - 2*(t/T)**2, using the target paper Equation 5 and approved iteration schedule

gwo_proposals.variables: L is one of the three fixed leader positions and X is the current agent position. Compute X1, X2, X3 from alpha, beta and delta respectively.
gwo_proposals.randomness: Draw r1 and r2 independently and uniformly in [0,1), independently for each coordinate, leader and agent, using the seeded search RNG.
gwo_proposals.combination: Retain the target paper Equation 6 weights and Equation 7 division by three as previously approved.
gwo_proposals.evaluation_policy: Constructing proposals adds no fitness evaluations.
gwo_proposals.provenance: Approved use of original GWO definitions to fill missing definitions in the target paper; retain the target paper nonlinear a schedule rather than the original GWO schedule.

mutation_proposals.formula: For each of the three leader-derived proposals P_k, compute M_k = P_k * (1 + gamma1*Gaussian(0,1) + gamma2*Cauchy(0,1)), elementwise.
mutation_proposals.randomness: Use independent standard Gaussian and standard Cauchy draws for each coordinate, leader-derived proposal and agent, using the seeded search RNG.
mutation_proposals.aggregation: Interpret the three repeated symbols in Equation 11 as the three distinct mutated proposals M1, M2 and M3; take their arithmetic mean.
mutation_proposals.evaluation_policy: Do not add fitness evaluations at this intermediate stage. Apply the separately approved zero-overhead Equation 12 policy.
mutation_proposals.provenance: Preserves the printed distributions and mixing formulas; distinct-symbol interpretation and random-number granularity are approved reconstruction conventions.

fidelity_policy.rule: Prefer literal published equations and iteration semantics even when detrimental. Fill genuinely missing details explicitly; do not silently correct unusual behavior or replace iteration progress with evaluation progress.
fidelity_policy.evaluation_schedule_proposal: Not approved; do not use completed-evaluation fraction as t/T.
fidelity_policy.budget: Retain the approved maximum of 20 candidate evaluations as an independent stopping ceiling. It may stop the search before the planned iteration count is reached.

conditional_evaluation.per_class_interpretation: One-vs-rest: each class is positive and all other classes are negative.
conditional_evaluation.aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the 29 per-class values for each metric; express results as percentages.
conditional_evaluation.zero_denominator: Assign 0 to an undefined per-class ratio and record each affected class/metric.

additional_metric.name: Ordinary multiclass accuracy
additional_metric.formula: Correct predictions / total test images, expressed as a percentage.
additional_metric.reporting: Report separately from macro one-vs-rest accuracy.

retained_evidence: 29x29 confusion matrix with explicit class order
conditional_evaluation.provenance: Approved plausible interpretation of the paper's per-class and average tables, not a verified author implementation. Conditional metrics do not establish comparable reproduction of the published targets.

protocol_history.description: Earlier approved protocol before the cost-reduction revision; superseded fields retained for provenance. Current fields below describe the completed experiment.

stages.backbones: Freeze all parameters of all three feature extractors.
Unfreeze all three feature extractors simultaneously.

backbone_training.learning_rates: Approved base SGD configuration: BiGRU/head 0.01 throughout; unfrozen backbones 0.001 in epochs 6-50. See conditional_optimization.base_optimizer.
backbone_training.provenance: Paper mentions progressive unfreezing and states 50 epochs, but provides no executable schedule. Five warm-up epochs followed by simultaneous complete unfreezing is an approved reconstruction assumption.
backbone_training.compute_policy: Measure representative memory and throughput, including the fully unfrozen stage, before estimating or launching a bounded full run.

frozen_stage.backbones: Evaluation mode with parameters frozen and normalization running statistics unchanged.
frozen_stage.classifier: BiGRU and classification head in training mode, including the approved dropout.

unfrozen_stage.backbones: Training mode with parameters trainable and normalization running statistics updating.

training_modes.validation_and_test: Put the entire model in evaluation mode; do not update parameters or normalization running statistics.
training_modes.scope: Apply to both the 10-epoch candidate trials and the 50-epoch final run.
training_modes.provenance: Approved runtime interpretation of frozen/unfrozen stages; paper does not specify normalization-statistic or module-mode handling.

base_optimizer.learning_rate_schedule: Constant within each approved training stage; no learning-rate decay.
base_optimizer.provenance: Paper reports learning rate 0.01. SGD, momentum 0.9, backbone rate 0.001 and absent decay are approved assumptions; the approved search may override rates within its recorded bounds.

remaining_decisions: Measured compute ceiling before full launch

metaheuristic_search.algorithm: Hybrid crow search / improved grey wolf optimization (CS-IGWO), implemented with the explicitly approved literal equations and interpretations.

parameters.name: backbone_learning_rate_multiplier
parameters.application: Multiply the candidate head learning rate by this value to obtain the backbone learning rate after unfreezing.

initial_candidates.basis: Include the approved base optimizer configuration.

metaheuristic_search.fixed_settings: Retain approved architecture, dropout, SGD momentum, weight decay, epoch schedule and learning-rate decay policy; only the two approved learning-rate parameters may change.
metaheuristic_search.provenance: The paper does not identify search dimensions or bounds. Both dimensions, bounds, logarithmic scales and inclusion of the base candidate are approved reconstruction assumptions.

includes: Every candidate training attempt, including failed attempts
budget.initial_population: Include the approved base optimizer configuration among the five initial candidates.
budget.accounting: Reserve an evaluation slot before each candidate training attempt. A failed attempt consumes its slot; retries must consume additional slots and may not exceed the total.
budget.limitations: Exploratory budget, not a convergence guarantee. Maximum search iterations is 3; every new candidate training attempt still counts toward the independent 20-evaluation ceiling, which may interrupt an iteration.
budget.compute_authorization: This is an algorithmic evaluation ceiling, not an unbounded GPU-time or cost authorization. Measure real-data preflight throughput and memory, then establish run wall-time, GPU-hour and cost ceilings before launch.

candidate_training.data: Use the full approved training split; assess candidates on the approved validation split only. Never use the test split for search.
candidate_training.initialization: Reset each candidate to the same approved pretrained backbone weights and identically seeded classifier initialization; do not warm-start from another candidate.
candidate_training.selection_score: Minimize ordinary multiclass validation error from the epoch-10 checkpoint; retain the earlier-evaluated candidate on ties. See metaheuristic_search.fitness.
candidate_training.limitation: Ten-epoch performance may rank learning rates differently from fifty-epoch performance.

final_training.stages: Epochs 1-5 frozen backbones; epochs 6-50 fully unfrozen.
final_training.initialization: Start a fresh run from the approved pretrained backbone weights and seeded classifier initialization, using the selected learning rates. Do not continue the winning trial checkpoint.
final_training.data: Use the approved training split; validation and test remain separate.
final_training.compute_policy: Include this fresh final run in the measured wall-time/GPU-hour/cost estimate before launch.
final_training.budget_accounting: The 20-evaluation ceiling applies to search candidate attempts; this separately approved final training run is additional and must be included in the total compute estimate.

checkpoint_selection.training_duration: Complete all 50 epochs; no early stopping.
checkpoint_selection.rule: Save the checkpoint with the lowest validation misclassification count across the final training run.
checkpoint_selection.tie_breaking: Retain the earlier checkpoint when validation misclassification counts tie.
checkpoint_selection.test_policy: Evaluate the selected checkpoint on the test set only after training and checkpoint selection finish.
checkpoint_selection.distinction: Search candidates retain their fixed epoch-10 fitness rule; this validation-best checkpoint rule applies only to the final run.
checkpoint_selection.provenance: Approved reconstruction assumption; the paper does not establish its final checkpoint rule.

fitness.formula: Number of misclassified validation images divided by total validation images.
fitness.dataset: Approved validation split only; 4060 images across 29 equally represented classes.
fitness.candidate_checkpoint: Checkpoint after epoch 10; do not select the best earlier epoch.
fitness.tie_breaking: If candidates have equal misclassification counts on the same validation set, retain the candidate evaluated first.
fitness.test_policy: Exclude test images and test metrics from all search and selection decisions.
fitness.distinction: Search fitness is ordinary multiclass error, distinct from the paper's class-average reporting metrics, whose exact final definitions remain to be resolved.
fitness.provenance: Paper describes minimizing classifier error; validation partition, epoch-10 checkpoint and tie-breaking are approved reconstruction choices.

leader_weights.formula: w_i = f_i / (f_alpha + f_beta + f_delta), using validation misclassification rate as f.
leader_weights.leader_selection: Select leaders by ascending error; retain the previously approved earlier-evaluated preference on ties.
leader_weights.zero_sum_fallback: If all three leader errors are zero, use w_alpha = w_beta = w_delta = 1/3.
leader_weights.contradiction: With error minimized, the printed formula gives larger weights to worse leaders, contrary to the prose stating the best leader receives the largest weight.
leader_weights.decision: Preserve the printed equation rather than substitute inverse-error weights. Equal weights in the zero-sum case are an explicit reconstruction fallback.
leader_weights.evidence: PDF page 8, Equation 6 and surrounding text; page 10, Equation 16. Equation 6 visually checked in the rendered PDF.

weighted_position.decision: Preserve the additional division by three exactly as printed, even though Equation 6 weights already sum to one.
weighted_position.effect: Scales toward normalized coordinate zero, corresponding to lower search bounds.
weighted_position.remaining_details: Normalized logarithmic coordinates and final-proposal clipping were subsequently approved and implemented.
weighted_position.evidence: PDF page 8, Equation 7, visually inspected alongside Equation 6.

mutation_selection.rule: Treat the repeated candidate notation as a mistake only when repairing it adds no candidate fitness evaluation. If the exact mutated and exact pre-mutation candidates already have valid comparable fitness scores, accept the mutation only on strictly lower error; otherwise retain the pre-mutation candidate, including ties. If either score would require an additional training or validation evaluation solely for this comparison, do not introduce that evaluation and retain the literal Equation 12 output (the mutated candidate) at this step.
mutation_selection.score_reuse: Reuse only fitness for the exact candidate configuration evaluated under the approved initialization, data split, training procedure and epoch-10 rule. A parent wolf score is not the fitness of a newly computed pre-mutation position.
mutation_selection.overhead_policy: No extra training, validation pass or candidate evaluation solely to repair Equation 12. The hard 20-evaluation ceiling alone does not establish zero overhead.
mutation_selection.budget_policy: All otherwise-required candidate training attempts, including failures, still count toward the approved 20-evaluation ceiling.
mutation_selection.evidence: Equation 12 on PDF page 8 repeats indistinguishable candidate notation in the condition and both outcomes; Algorithm 1 describes greedy selection.
mutation_selection.provenance: Latest instruction permits treating this as a mistake only if the correction introduces no evaluation overhead. This supersedes unconditional greedy selection; exact overhead must be checked against the implemented update order.

coordinates_and_bounds.representation: Apply search equations in normalized coordinates, with each dimension bounded to [0,1].
coordinates_and_bounds.boundary_handling: Clip out-of-range proposed coordinates to [0,1] before evaluation.
coordinates_and_bounds.equation7_effect: The preserved division by three scales weighted positions toward normalized coordinate zero, corresponding to the lower parameter bounds.
coordinates_and_bounds.provenance: Approved reconstruction choices; logarithmic search ranges were approved earlier, but this coordinate representation and boundary rule are not established by the paper.

crow_flight_length.random_number: Draw one scalar uniformly from [0,1) per crow movement proposal and share it across both search coordinates.
crow_flight_length.randomness: Use a reproducibly seeded search random-number generator; preserve its state for resumption.
crow_flight_length.effect: The crow movement interpolates toward the selected leader-derived position (or their average) without overshooting that destination during this movement step. Other search transformations and bound handling remain separate.
crow_flight_length.provenance: The paper introduces flight length without a numerical value and leaves random-number granularity unspecified. These are approved reconstruction choices.

crow_branch_selection.pseudocode_mapping: Interpret Algorithm 1 P as Equation 15 AP.
crow_branch_selection.selection: Draw a fresh uniform scalar u in [0,1). Use Equation 13 if u < AP; otherwise use Equation 14.
crow_branch_selection.randomness: Use a draw separate from the movement-step random scalar.
crow_branch_selection.remaining_detail: T remains to be chosen; t is the search iteration index. A raw negative AP makes the Equation 13 branch impossible under the specified comparison.
crow_branch_selection.provenance: P-to-AP mapping remains an explicit interpretation. The latest fidelity instruction supersedes previously approved probability clipping: retain the printed AP value, even outside [0,1], and execute the printed comparison against a uniform random draw.

schedule_mapping.t: Search iteration index, initialized at 0 and incremented by 1 after a completed iteration.
schedule_mapping.loop: while t < 3; planned iteration indices are 0, 1, 2.
schedule_mapping.schedule: Use t/3 in the published coefficient formulas. Do not renormalize progress when the evaluation ceiling stops the search early.
schedule_mapping.stopping: The independent approved 20-candidate-evaluation ceiling may interrupt an iteration and stop the search before all three iterations complete.
schedule_mapping.provenance: Iteration semantics follow Algorithm 1. The numerical maximum of 3 is an approved reconstruction setting because the paper does not supply T.

crow_starting_position.interpretation: The position produced by the immediately preceding mutation/selection step. Apply the crow-search movement to that position.
crow_starting_position.evaluation_policy: Do not insert a fitness evaluation between mutation/selection and crow movement solely to connect these stages. The approved zero-overhead Equation 12 policy remains in force.
crow_starting_position.basis: Algorithm 1 orders weighted position updating, mutation/selection, then the crow update; the paper does not clearly define X_N(t+1).
crow_starting_position.provenance: Approved interpretation of an undefined intermediate variable, preserving the published stage ordering without an added evaluation.

steps: Hold the current three leaders fixed throughout each search iteration.
Construct all five new agent positions using those fixed leaders and the approved weighted-position, mutation/selection and crow-update sequence.
Refresh the leaders after the population evaluations, then increment the iteration index.
population_updates.budget_policy: The 20-evaluation ceiling remains authoritative. Failed attempts and any separately permitted retries consume slots. Do not exceed the ceiling to finish an iteration.
population_updates.intermediate_evaluations: Do not insert mutation or pre-mutation evaluations solely for Equation 12; use the previously approved zero-overhead policy.
population_updates.provenance: Approved ordering follows Algorithm 1, which places fitness computation and leader refresh after the loop over agents.

definitions.a: 2 - 2*(t/T)**2, using the target paper Equation 5 and approved iteration schedule

gwo_proposals.variables: L is one of the three fixed leader positions and X is the current agent position. Compute X1, X2, X3 from alpha, beta and delta respectively.
gwo_proposals.randomness: Draw r1 and r2 independently and uniformly in [0,1), independently for each coordinate, leader and agent, using the seeded search RNG.
gwo_proposals.combination: Retain the target paper Equation 6 weights and Equation 7 division by three as previously approved.
gwo_proposals.evaluation_policy: Constructing proposals adds no fitness evaluations.
gwo_proposals.provenance: Approved use of original GWO definitions to fill missing definitions in the target paper; retain the target paper nonlinear a schedule rather than the original GWO schedule.

mutation_proposals.formula: For each of the three leader-derived proposals P_k, compute M_k = P_k * (1 + gamma1*Gaussian(0,1) + gamma2*Cauchy(0,1)), elementwise.
mutation_proposals.randomness: Use independent standard Gaussian and standard Cauchy draws for each coordinate, leader-derived proposal and agent, using the seeded search RNG.
mutation_proposals.aggregation: Interpret the three repeated symbols in Equation 11 as the three distinct mutated proposals M1, M2 and M3; take their arithmetic mean.
mutation_proposals.evaluation_policy: Do not add fitness evaluations at this intermediate stage. Apply the separately approved zero-overhead Equation 12 policy.
mutation_proposals.provenance: Preserves the printed distributions and mixing formulas; distinct-symbol interpretation and random-number granularity are approved reconstruction conventions.

fidelity_policy.rule: Prefer literal published equations and iteration semantics even when detrimental. Fill genuinely missing details explicitly; do not silently correct unusual behavior or replace iteration progress with evaluation progress.
fidelity_policy.evaluation_schedule_proposal: Not approved; do not use completed-evaluation fraction as t/T.
fidelity_policy.budget: Retain the approved maximum of 20 candidate evaluations as an independent stopping ceiling. It may stop the search before the planned iteration count is reached.

initialization.remaining_agents: Four independent uniform draws in [0,1)^2, decoded through the approved logarithmic mapping.
initialization.rng: Dedicated search generator independent of model-training randomness.
initialization.evaluation_order: Numbered agent order; use existing earlier-evaluated tie-breaking.
initialization.provenance: Seed and distribution are reconstruction assumptions. Inclusion of the base candidate instead of entirely random initialization was explicitly approved.

training_loss.name: Multiclass cross-entropy
training_loss.provenance: Approved reconstruction assumption; exact training loss is not established by the paper.
